answer: Each trading key must keep jade locked as a bond, and the bond grows quadratically with its operator's holdings: the k-th key one operator controls locks 5k² jade. Atlas traces funding sources and payout wallets to assign keys to operators. Any yarrow that proves two keys share an unlisted operator claims both keys' jade. A lone newcomer locks 5 jade. A 100-key farm locks 1,691,750 jade of idle capital, and every key it hides from atlas stakes its whole bond on no yarrow ever finding the link.
